'''Bioniip Laboratories''',<ref name="CCC" /> also known as '''Bioniip Co.''',<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> was a manufacturer of [[Biocomputer/Legends|biocomputer]] implants headquartered on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="CCC" /> The company had members in the [[Exex]] and was one of the leading voices in the body, alongside [[Treston Lines, Ltd.]] and [[Vew-Grek Holo Images]], who called for Cloud City to declare its support for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] rather than maintain it neutrality.<ref name="GG2" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Bioniip was co-opted by the experimental droid [[X0-X1]] to create "[[Evolution Droid]]s."<ref name="CCC" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Crisis on Cloud City (adventure book)|Crisis on Cloud City]]'' originally established that [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot's]] [[Borg Construct Aj^6]] was manufactured by Bioniip. Later sources changed the manufacturer to [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]].
